faq.q: What is the origin of Aarfa?
faq.a: Aarfa is associated with Arabic. عرفة is the name of the plain near Mecca associated with the Hajj. Its use as a personal name is reported but not verified from a Tier-A/B source.
Yes — the underlying form عرفة is Arabic.
Aarfa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
